title: Marimekko market composition
intent: Encode one categorical total as column width and its internal composition as stacked height.

ai.create: Create a Marimekko chart where market totals determine column widths and each market's segment mix determines normalized vertical cells, using granular d3-array preparation and typed rectangle endpoints.
ai.maintain: Add a market or segment while preserving the two independent normalization denominators, explicit ordering, stable cell identity, labels, colors, and complete zero-to-one bounds.
